turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there! How's your day treating you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That interview went so badly. I totally blanked on the question about teamwork.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Oof, that happens. For the follow up email, do you want to briefly address that answer, or keep it to a simple thank you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait a moment, my coworker is here. Please be quiet until I tell you I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Have you been practicing your guitar this week?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: A little. My fingertips still hurt on the steel strings.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That goes away after a few weeks. Which song are you learning?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Just the easy campfire ones. Four chords, over and over.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's how everyone starts. Play me one later?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Only if you promise not to laugh.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, back. Thanks for being patient.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. The follow up email. Are you mentioning the teamwork answer?
